text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was getting ready for the training camp,
St Lite called out to me—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Seeing <chrname>'s remarkable growth
is truly a delight, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"However...
She will reach even greater heights."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
What I gained from my active racing days...
What I felt watching over my beloved young ones...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: I am prepared to pour everything into <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"To ensure you attain the glory you deserve—
I shall impart further guidance upon you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guided by St. Lite...
<chrname> gained wonderful insight!
